jobs.spark: Agent chat with tool calling, letter reading with vision and structured output
jobs.voice: Turns a spoken answer into text
jobs.sam: Outlines the letter in a photo so you see what was read
jobs.image: Paints the results banner from life areas only, never personal details
jobs.wonder: Writes the call notes people rely on most: what to say, what to have ready
jobs.open: Open-weights model on Baseten or Fireworks that removes names, numbers and addresses before your words reach any hosted model

rules.title: Rules Beacon keeps
rules.lead: Written into the code, so they hold for every check.

list.r1: Code decides each result. Models read, ask and explain.
list.r2: Nothing a model writes reaches the rules until code has checked it.
list.r3: Letters are read in quarantine and become typed data before any agent that can act sees them.
list.r4: Beacon never asks for a name, a National Insurance or Social Security number, or bank details, and doesn't copy them from letters.
list.r5: Answers live in your browser. The server forgets them when the request ends.
list.r6: Every scheme links to its official page. The organisation that runs it decides.
